card.line: Ekron was the northernmost of the five main Philistine cities, where the ark of God caused great fear and where King Ahaziah wrongly sought help from Baal-zebub.

moments.title: The ark comes to Ekron
moments.text: The Philistines sent the ark of God to Ekron. The people cried out in fear that it would kill them, so the rulers were told to send it back to its place.

moments.title: Rulers return to Ekron
moments.text: The five Philistine rulers watched the ark reach Beth-shemesh and then went back to Ekron. The Philistines had sent a gold tumor for each of their cities, including Ekron, as a guilt offering to the LORD.

moments.title: The Philistines flee to Ekron
moments.text: After David struck down Goliath, Israel and Judah charged forward with a shout. They chased the Philistines to the gates of Ekron, and bodies lay along the road.
